description: This file defines the DefaultReadFilter class in PhpSpreadsheet, implementing the IReadFilter interface to control whether individual cells should be read during spreadsheet processing.

classes.name: DefaultReadFilter
classes.description: A class implementing IReadFilter to determine if a cell should be read, currently set to always return true.

methods.name: readCell
methods.description: Determines if a particular cell should be read based on its column address, row number, and worksheet name. Currently always returns true.
